blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several candidates were leading in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) parliamentary elections, based on the partial and unofficial parallel count by the Parish Pastoral Council for Responsible Voting (PPCRV) on Monday night.

The initial figures from PPCRV’s Initial Election Transmission cover the six sectoral seats being contested by voters for settler communities, women, youth, ulama or Islamic scholars, and traditional leaders. The rankings and vote totals may still change as more election returns are processed and canvassed.
For the settler communities sector, voters are choosing two representatives to represent settler communities in the Bangsamoro Parliament.
